description: Throwaway demo for tools/extlink_driver -- NOT an existing lab task. Proves an external (extlink) signal can drive a live FDA transition with no animal and no hardware: state changes are dispatched to ES by the FDA itself, so the state name alone is the observable. wait->armed and armed->fired are deliberately NOT shipped in this file -- they must be authored by hand in the FDA editor (plan 18-12's checkpoint) against the extlink option group for the demo module, using a threshold crossed in both directions so `extlink_driver.py --sweep` visibly cycles the state. Shipping those two transitions here would let the checkpoint be satisfied by curl instead of proving the editor's picker actually works. See tools/extlink_driver/README.md for the exact option group and label to select, and for the two threshold expressions to enter. No entry actions anywhere in this file -- no valve, no reward, no INC_TRIAL_COUNTER -- which is what makes it safe to run on the rig pilot with no animal in the box.

transitions.description: Unconditional -- closes the demo cycle on its own once fired is reached.
